'''December 2000 Lexington tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lexington, KY on 2 December 2000. [[Matt Baker]] won it. It is known from Matt Baker's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1522">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-10-lexington-ky-12-2-00d1522/ lexington-ky-12-2-00], DeckTech (Matt "kjerg" Baker, 10 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-10-lexington-ky-12-2-00d1522/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Lexington, KY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Baker]]
